visual_check.safety_consequence: No absolute Q1/Q8-to-algebraic-label phase is inferred from inaccessible Figure-1.7 pixels; only printed text and replayable extracted figure labels are used.

figure1_7_double_cover.construction: Draw a cross joining the six algebraic Weierstrass points; the line from +1 to infinity is dashed; lift to the genus-2 double cover.
figure1_7_double_cover.one_sheet_semantics: Continuing the printed journey runs around the upper half of the octagon; the other sheet is its conjugate and the sheets are glued along the dotted line.

figure3_PQ_tessellation.R: orientation-preserving rotation of order 8 around the origin/centre; preserves P1,P2
figure3_PQ_tessellation.S: reflection in the real line; Q_i -> Q_{9-i}; preserves P1,P2
figure3_PQ_tessellation.T: reflection switching P1 and P2; preserves Q_i
figure3_PQ_tessellation.U: orientation-preserving rotation of order 3 around a (4,4,4) triangle centre
figure3_PQ_tessellation.figure3_2_sheet_semantics: P_i and Q_j are Weierstrass-point representatives; bar notation means the other sheet of the cover; source explicitly says compare Figure 1.7.

algebraic_branch_labels_to_cook_double_c.reason: Cook prints the algebraic model, names the six branch/Weierstrass values, and constructs Figure 1.7 by an explicitly labelled lift.

cook_double_cover_octagon_to_PQ_weierstr.reason: Figure 3.2 states that its P/Q vertices represent Weierstrass points, bar notation is the other sheet, and explicitly directs comparison with Figure 1.7.

absolute_P1_P2_to_zero_infinity_ordered_.missing: The prose does not explicitly say P1=infinity and P2=0 (or the reverse). Figure 1.7 pixel geometry could potentially resolve this, but that page was not replayably available to the screenshot tool in this preflight.

absolute_Q1_algebraic_label.missing: The source text does not name Q1 or Q8 as one of +1,-1,+i,-i. The cyclic Q-index phase relative to algebraic branch labels is therefore not source-bound in replayable text.

cook_R_to_kuusalo_f1_literal_binding.missing: Both are order-8 centre rotations on Bolza presentations, but no source-side exact conjugating map/orientation identifies Cook R with Kuusalo's literal f1 rather than an inverse/conjugate.

cook_U_to_kuusalo_f2_literal_binding.missing: Cook supplies a concrete order-3 triangle-centre rotation, but without the absolute Q phase there is no exact algebraic branch permutation that can be equated to one of the four R4 candidates.

finite_phase_replay.observation: The four R4 candidates pair infinity with the four possible consecutive ordered pairs in the algebraic side-centre cycle. Cook's U cycle P1->Q8->Q1 selects such an ordered pair only after an absolute Q-index-to-algebraic phase is fixed.

new_information_over_r7: Cook places an algebraically labelled double-cover octagon and a P/Q-labelled regular-octagon triangle tessellation in the same source.
The source explicitly links the P/Q sheet notation back to Figure 1.7 and supplies a concrete order-3 action U on P/Q labels.
Thus the missing object is narrowed from a generic algebraic-label-to-octagon adapter to one absolute cyclic Q-index phase (and, conservatively, the ordered P1/P2 identification).
remaining_obstruction: No replayable printed statement assigns Q1 (or Q8) to +1,-1,+i,-i.
The unavailable Figure-1.7 pixel geometry must not be used as an implicit selector.
Without that phase, U has four equally compatible algebraic branch permutations matching the R4 r-conjugacy orbit.
ambiguity_analysis.minimal_new_datum: One source-bound statement/figure-coordinate giving the algebraic label of one Cook Q_i (equivalently the absolute Q cyclic phase), together with a checked P1/P2={infinity,0} ordering if needed.

decision.next_source_candidate: Felix Werner Jenni, Ueber das Spektrum des Laplace-Operators auf einer Schar kompakter Riemannscher Flaechen, Basel dissertation (1981), especially the original P/Q and R,S,T,U figures/conventions cited by Cook.
decision.next_question: Does Jenni's original convention explicitly attach one P/Q label or the real-axis orientation to an algebraic branch value, thereby fixing Cook's remaining Q-index phase?
